what: cputest/readme.txt and cputest/cputestgen.ini — the CPU tester's recipe and its preset list (which cases are generated: every instruction and addressing mode, trace, odd source/destination, odd user stack, odd exception vectors, interrupts, and bus errors). This is the harness that is compared against real Amigas.
not_vendored: the expected values: they are produced by the tester core `gencpu` emits when built with CPU_TESTER, and judged on the Amiga side against hardware. Building that core on Linux is ticket #72.
what_it_checks: every register, SR and PC; the exception number and the whole group-0 frame field by field; memory writes; undefined CCR bits; the clock total including exception processing to within 2 clocks ($DFF006)
hardware_scope: author's reports: '09.02.2020 All 68000 tests are 100% confirmed, including full cycle-count support'; 'All prefetch bus error tests verified' (16.02.2020)

referee_run_cited.result: 308416 of 314988 judged cases agree against SingleStepTests/m68000; all 779253 judgeable cases agree against SingleStepTests/680x0 where CLK and MAME's core agree
